verdict.rationale: Framer documents a native External Agent connection that gives Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex direct access to the canvas, components, CMS, and project context, offered in place of a separate MCP server. The docs frame this mainly as agents working on and updating a Framer project, not as pulling design context out to implement it in code elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit read access to frames, variables/tokens, screenshots, and component-to-code mappings; documentation of the External Agent or Server API read surface; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: the native Framer External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex... direct access to your canvas, components, CMS, and project context, without manual MCP setup
